text:
mina: Ran through the Compliance demo and noticed a recurring confusion: the small encryption badge next to region reads to customers as a region property. Quick thread to propose a few changes and collect owners.

kai: Thanks. What's the concrete issue?

mina: Two problems: 1) badge ordering/labeling makes it read like "Region: EU, Encryption: true" which conflates key ownership with location; 2) screen readers only read "badge" / "chip" with no context.

rachel: +1 on clarity. Proposal that differs from previous threads: use a short visual token and an explicit prefix in the accessible label. Visible token: `Customer key (BYOK)` or `Redwood key`. Visually prepend with an icon+divider so it doesn't look like a region attribute. Accessible label: `Encryption method: Customer-managed key (BYOK). Activate for key details.` This keeps the visible UI short but gives full context to SR users.

mina: I also want telemetry on confusion. Suggest we instrument two metrics before/after: `badge_click_rate` and `help_hovers_per_session`. If badge_click_rate is high and many open the details panel, that's a sign the token is ambiguous. Ops: can we add those events to the analytics schema?

ops-bot: Logged analytics task ANALYTICS-554: add `badge_click` and `badge_help_hover` events for Security > Data settings. Tags: analytics, ux.

design-bot: UX suggestion: try two variants in an experiment: A) token placed left of region with thin divider; B) token grouped in a separate metadata row under the header. We'll run both with telemetry and compare. Also propose a microcopy option where the visible token is purely the short phrase and we add a subtle `?` help link that opens a small inline panel.

kai: On SR semantics, prefer `aria-label` that reads the ownership then immediately says it opens details: `aria-label=\"Encryption method: Customer key (BYOK). Opens key details.\"`. Also add `aria-describedby` referencing a hidden element with id `encryption-explainer` that reads: `Encryption describes who controls the encryption key; storage region is shown separately.` When the details panel opens, change the hidden node to `role=status` so screen readers announce the new state.

rachel: We also need to fix keyboard order. Right now the token is after the region in DOM so tooltips and toggles get focus before it. Move the token earlier in DOM or use tabindex adjustments so tab order matches reading order. Add a visible 2px high-contrast focus ring (prefer system token) for keyboard users.

mina: CSV/export debate: some customers parse CSVs programmatically. There's been previous suggestions to rename `time` to `event_time_utc`, but I'm leaning to `timestamp_utc` because it's shorter and aligns with other exports. Thoughts? We need a final name and a deprecation plan.\

l10n-bot: i18n note: whichever header we pick, avoid punctuation and keep keys stable. For visible CSV event text, prefer sentence-case like `Key rotated` rather than machine verbs. That helps translations and downstream readability.

kai: I prefer `timestamp_utc` too. Ops: if we change header, please keep server alias `time` for at least two releases and emit a deprecation warning in export metadata. Also include `action_code` column for machine consumers while `event` remains human readable. Example suggestion for CSV:

```
timestamp_utc,action_code,event,user_email,details
2024-11-02T14:32:00Z,KEY_ROTATE,Key rotated,admin@example.com,Customer key rotated to v3
```

This keeps backwards compatibility and provides both machine and human-friendly fields.

ops-bot: Created ticket RDO-804: CSV header rename proposal + aliasing plan. Will coordinate deprecation notes.

rachel: Another minor idea to reduce confusion: change visible abbreviation `BYOK` to `Customer key (BYOK)` where BYOK is parenthetical so unfamiliar customers see full phrase. For localization, the parenthetical can be removed if translators prefer. Keep the short token on narrow screens.

mina: Good. Also docs sync: once we pick copy, update Data residency screenshots and the KMS quickstart. Otherwise help articles will be out of sync. I'll file the docs task.

ops-bot: Docs task DOCS-412 queued for screenshot updates (depends on RDO-804).

l10n-bot: I'll preflight translations for the four candidate strings: short token (`Customer key (BYOK)`, `Redwood key`), aria labels, tooltip explainer, and the CSV header `timestamp_utc`. Please avoid special characters in translation keys.

kai: Implementation notes for engineers: 1) move token earlier in markup; 2) use `role=button`, `tabindex=0`, `aria-haspopup=dialog` if it opens modal; 3) `aria-describedby` -> `#encryption-explainer`; 4) strong focus ring; 5) fire analytics events `badge_click` and `badge_help_hover`.

mina: Owners: kai for aria and dev changes, rachel for copy + design mock, ops for analytics + CSV alias. I'll coordinate docs. Target: small patch in next sprint.

rachel: I'll drop two Figma frames (left-of-region vs separate row) and attach copy variants.

mina: Thanks everyone. Once mocks are up we'll run the telemetry experiment and loop back in ~2 weeks.

ops-bot: Linked RDO-804 and ANALYTICS-554 to epic RDO-700.

l10n-bot: Flagged translation task UX-4200.

mina: Closing this thread. If anyone sees odd translation regressions or analytics gaps, ping here.
